events.title: Demo Update: New Areas, Capsule Arts, Reworked Gilman Estate & Bug Fixes
events.summary: 18,000 Wishlists. Thank You!Before anything else: Late Night Manifest just passed 18,000 wishlists! Every day, during my morning walks, in my mind, I do pre-feasibility studies on the game's story and the mechanics I'll add.At the moment, development is on the interior of the house.
